Object.Name: Rick Roll
Object.Description1: This object provides a standard interface for delivering an unexpected musical experience to unsuspecting IoT device operators. When triggered, the device will never give you up, never let you down, never run around and desert you. Compliant devices MUST implement the Trigger Rick Roll resource and SHOULD display appropriate lyrics.

Item.Name: Bait Description
Item.Description: A compelling but deceptive description designed to lure the target into triggering the Rick Roll. Examples: "Click here for free firmware update", "Important security patch", "System diagnostic results".

Item.Name: Redirect URL
Item.Description: The URL to which the target will be redirected upon triggering. Default value: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ

Item.Name: Artist
Item.Description: The performing artist. This value is fixed and SHALL be "Rick Astley".

Item.Name: Song Title
Item.Description: The title of the song that will be played. This value is fixed and SHALL be "Never Gonna Give You Up".

Item.Name: Release Year
Item.Description: The year the song was released. This value is fixed and SHALL be 1987.

Item.Name: Roll Count
Item.Description: The cumulative number of times this device has successfully Rick Rolled a target since last power cycle. A high value indicates a particularly deceptive device.

Item.Name: Current Lyric
Item.Description: The current lyric line being displayed or broadcast by the device. Implementations SHOULD cycle through all verses in order.

Item.Name: Autoplay
Item.Description: When set to True, the device will automatically Rick Roll any new LwM2M client that registers with it. Default: False. Use responsibly.

Item.Name: Volume
Item.Description: Playback volume as a percentage. It is RECOMMENDED to always set this to 100 for maximum effect. Setting to 0 is unsportsmanlike conduct.

Item.Name: Trigger Rick Roll
Item.Description: Executes the Rick Roll operation. Upon execution, the device SHALL redirect any connected display to the Redirect URL, play "Never Gonna Give You Up" at the configured Volume, increment the Roll Count, and update the Current Lyric resource.

Item.Name: Reset Roll Count
Item.Description: Resets the Roll Count to zero. This operation does not undo any Rick Rolls that have already been delivered.

Object.Description2: Note: This object is provided in the spirit of RFC 3514 (The Evil Bit) and RFC 2549 (IP over Avian Carriers). Implementors are reminded that while RFC compliance is important, the true spirit of this object lies in its execution.
